fix_subject: Validate the records, buffer_size and hive_types reader parameters
pr_title: Merge #26701: Validate the records, buffer_size and hive_types reader parameters

labels.summary: Reader parameters were not validated: read_json's records option mishandled non-VARCHAR/non-BOOLEAN values, read_csv's buffer_size accepted negative values that wrapped when cast to idx_t, and an empty hive_types struct tripped an assertion instead of raising a proper error.
